verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
scope_comparison: The latest Liu arXiv2610.00390v2 Theorems1–3 and section6 concern complexity/exact synthesis for individual rational plants, including two-input ETR completeness and single-input NP-hardness. They do not classify Euclidean-density stabilization for all critical dimension pairs n=mp. Zenodo23074149 is the same work; the accessible latest arXiv body resolves the material comparison gap.
